blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Langley total for condos and townhomes that month.

items.t: Plan-area boundaries (planning, not board): per the Willoughby Community Plan Area description in Bylaw No. 6201, the plan area is bordered by the municipal boundary with the City of Surrey to the southwest, Highway 1 to the north, the ridgeline of the Trans Mountain Pipeline right-of-way and Lower Mainland Regional Park and 68 Avenue to the south, and 216 Street and the Willowbrook Connector to the east.

Mountain Secondary, 7633 202A St. Catchments are address-based: the recorded SD35 locator run for 7888 200 Street returns Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary, Peter Ewart Middle School and R.E. Mountain Secondary.

Parks, transit and health: Langley Events Centre, 7888 200 Street, is a Township-owned multi-purpose sports and events facility with Willoughby Community Park beside it; Muriel Arnason Library is at 130 - 20338 65 Avenue (Fraser Valley Regional Library). Langley Memorial Hospital, 22051 Fraser Highway, is the Fraser Health community hospital for Langley.

items.t: Township plans — current position: the existing Willoughby Community Plan (Bylaw 1836, 1979) now sits as Schedule 6 to the Township's Official Community Plan as updated by OCP Bylaw 6200, adopted December 1, 2025.

Township zoning and SSMUH: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 governs. The Residential Compact Lot Zone R-CL (s. 403) runs from a minimum lot area of 220 m² to a maximum of 464.5 m², with minimum frontage 11 m front-loaded and 8.2 m rear-loaded. Secondary suites (s. 102) are capped at a maximum gross floor area of 120 m², one per principal dwelling unit, with a building permit required. SSMUH Bylaw 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024) allows 3 units on eligible lots of 280 m² or smaller and 4 units on larger eligible lots up to 4,050 m²; lots over 4,050 m² are ineligible, and the Township has no six-unit tier.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in Willoughby Heights
The Towers at Latimer Heights — Tower A at 8551 201 Street and Tower B at 20065 85 Avenue

Two concrete towers by Vesta Properties, described in a presale-directory summary as Langley's first concrete high-rise condominium community, with nearly 500 homes including condos and townhomes, construction completed in 2024; listings for units in both towers confirm built 2024 and concrete construction. Because the published "nearly 500" figure mixes condos and townhomes, the apartment-condo unit count alone is not confirmed. Restrictions: Not confirmed from public sources.
Latimer Village (Vesta Properties) — low-rise buildings including 20019 83A Avenue, 8380 200A Street and 20052 83A Avenue

Listings describe Latimer Village as part of Vesta's 74-acre Latimer Heights master-planned community; units at 20019 83A Avenue are listed as built 2022 and units at 8380 200A Street as built 2023, with wood-frame construction shown for 8380 200A Street. A total unit count for the Latimer Village condo buildings alone is not confirmed — published community totals cover the whole 74-acre project, not these buildings. Restrictions: Not confirmed, other than individual listings showing pets with restrictions for single units, which is listing data, not a verified building bylaw summary.
Yorkson Park (Quadra Homes) — a multi-address low-rise group including 20328 86 Avenue, 20290 86 Avenue, 20376 86 Avenue and 8561 203A Street

The building directory listing for 20328 86 Avenue records complex name Yorkson Park, strata plan EPS7248, built 2021, and 31 units at that one address; listings at the other Yorkson Park addresses show built 2021–2022 and Quadra Homes as builder, with retractable-glass solariums a recurring feature. The group-wide unit count is not confirmed — do not add the 31-unit single-address figure up as a project total. Restrictions: Not confirmed from public sources. (building directory, secondary source)
Yorkson Downs (Quadra) — 20716 Willoughby Town Centre Drive (buildings A and B)

Listings show built 2019, apartment/condo subtype, wood-frame construction, underground parking, and one listing stating rentals allowed and pets allowed with restrictions for that unit. Unit count: Not confirmed from public sources. The rental/pet lines are single-listing data, not a verified bylaw summary — confirm on the Form B.
Union Park (Polygon) — 8150 207 Street

A presale-directory summary describes Union Park as four 6-storey wood-frame buildings with 589 market condominiums at 82 Avenue and 208 Street (secondary source); listings for units at 8150 207 Street show built 2021, apartment/condo subtype, underground parking, and the 12,000 sq ft Union Club amenity building with outdoor pool, hot tub and gym. Restrictions: Not confirmed from public sources, other than individual listings showing pets for single units.
Yorkson Creek Parkside 2 — 8157 207 Street

Built 2016, 188 units (building directory, secondary source). The directory records the restrictions as: pets allowed with restrictions, rentals allowed. Amenities listed: elevator, exercise centre. (building directory, secondary source)
Yorkson Creek — 8328 207A Street
Named in current listings as the building for units at 8328 207A Street, apartment/condo subtype. Year built, unit count, construction and restrictions: Not confirmed from the sources checked.
Walnut Park (Quadra Homes) — 208 Street and 83 Avenue, Yorkson

A presale-directory summary describes 211 condominiums and three ground-level commercial units in two 6-storey wood-frame buildings (secondary source). Completion status and final unit count as built: Not confirmed until completion is published. Restrictions: Not confirmed.
The Hive (Apcon Group) — 7920 206 Street (Hive 1) and 7936 206 Street (Hive 2), Willoughby Town Centre

Two 6-storey wood-frame buildings with 240 condominiums in total (presale-directory summary, secondary source); a trade-press account splits that as an 84-unit first phase and a 156-unit Hive 2. Listings show Hive 1 units built 2024 and Hive 2 units built 2025, wood-frame construction, underground parking. Restrictions: Not confirmed from public sources.
Elements — 20211 66 Avenue

A multi-building low-rise complex (buildings lettered A through F in listings) at the south end of Willoughby. Listings show wood-frame construction and give different built years by building — examples checked show 2013, 2015, 2017 and 2018 — so a single project year would be wrong; the phase-by-phase years are not confirmed beyond those listing examples. Amenity building is marketed as the Trilogy Club. Unit count for the whole complex: Not confirmed. Restrictions: Not confirmed, other than listings showing cats OK for single units.
Matteo (ML Emporio) — 7588 198B Street at 76 Avenue

Two 6-storey wood-frame buildings with 212 condominiums plus ground-floor retail, under construction in current listings; developer marketing material in listings states completion in mid-2028, and listing built-years appear variously as 2026 and 2028 depending on the unit — treat the building as a presale, not a completed building, and the completion date as not confirmed until the disclosure statement is read. Restrictions: Not confirmed.

items.t: "Willoughby Heights" is the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board sub-area name in the SnapStats FVR September 2026 report; the Township of Langley's official planning name is "Willoughby." The Willoughby Community Plan Area in Bylaw No. 6201 is bordered by the Surrey municipal boundary to the southwest, Highway 1 to the north, the Trans Mountain Pipeline right-of-way ridgeline, Lower Mainland Regional Park and 68 Avenue to the south, and 216 Street and the Willowbrook Connector to the east.

Where the condo stock concentrates: (1) the Latimer Heights / 200 Street corridor around 83 Avenue–86 Avenue — The Towers, Latimer Village, Yorkson Park and Yorkson Downs; (2) the Yorkson / 208 Street node around 82 Avenue–83 Avenue — Union Park, Yorkson Creek Parkside 2, Yorkson Creek and Walnut Park; (3) Willoughby Town Centre around 206 Street and 80 Avenue — The Hive and Yorkson Downs on Willoughby Town Centre Drive; (4) the southwest Willoughby edge — Elements on 66 Avenue and Matteo at 198B Street and 76 Avenue.

Transit and landmark anchors named in Township and TransLink material are the Langley Events Centre at 7888 200 Street, the Carvolth Exchange area at 200 Street and Highway 1, and routes 501 (Surrey Central–Langley Centre via 200 Street), 372 and 595.

The Willoughby Community Plan Update (Bylaws No. 6201, 6202 and 6203) replaced the old Willoughby Community Plan and created the Willoughby Transit Corridor Plan and the Gordon Neighbourhood Plan; the Transit Corridor is the high-density spine where further condo form is planned.

Willoughby's compact-lot pattern is the Residential Compact Lot Zone R-CL: under s. 403.7, R-CL lots run from a minimum lot area of 220 m² to a maximum of 464.5 m², with minimum frontage of 11 m front-loaded and 8.2 m rear-loaded — the detached and townhouse fabric the condo buildings sit among.

items.t: The plan changed in 2026-era bylaws: Bylaws No. 6201, 6202 and 6203 replaced the Willoughby Community Plan and created the Willoughby Transit Corridor Plan and the Gordon Neighbourhood Plan — what gets built beside a condo bought today follows the new plans, and the Transit Corridor is the designated high-density spine.

The Towers' headline count mixes product types: the published "nearly 500 homes" for The Towers at Latimer Heights includes townhomes as well as condos, so resale depth for the towers alone is smaller than the headline suggests.

Yorkson Park is not one building: the name covers several addresses on and around 86 Avenue and 203A Street (20328, 20290 and 20376 86 Avenue; 8561 203A Street), and the directory's 31-unit figure belongs to 20328 86 Avenue only, strata plan EPS7248. Comparing fees or reports across "Yorkson Park" units without checking which strata plan the unit sits in is a known trap. (building directory, secondary source)

Trinity Western University's Smith campus is in southeast Willoughby at 8086 208 Street, and the Township's plan background names a campus expansion in southeast Willoughby — part of the rental-demand backdrop for the Yorkson buildings, stated as context only; no rental-yield figure is published in the sources checked.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Willoughby Heights
Cascadia (StreetSide Developments, Qualico) — 6951 204 Street. Strata

Listings and the building directory describe 2- to 3-bedroom, 3-storey townhomes in clusters, built 2024, with 233 homes, wood-frame construction, title Freehold Strata, strata plan EPS9777. A current listing records strata restrictions as pets allowed with restrictions and rentals allowed with restrictions (listing data — confirm on the Form B). (building directory, secondary source)
Luxia at Yorkson — 7947 209 Street. Strata

138 three-bedroom townhouses by Isle of Mann Property Group and Pollyco Group, on a 5.44-acre site; listings record Sub-Type Townhouse / Row-Townhouse, Title to Land Freehold Strata, built 2021–2022 by unit, with a clubhouse and exercise centre among amenities. Strata plan EPS5794 is recorded in a strata-buildings index (secondary source). Published rental/pet restrictions: Not confirmed beyond listing amenity data — confirm on the Form B.
Yorkson Creek (Quadra Homes) — 20738 84 Avenue. Strata

Listings record Sub-Type Townhouse / Row-Townhouse, Title to Land Freehold Strata, built 2012, with clubhouse and exercise centre amenities; one full-report listing records 171 total units in the strata while another building summary records 152 units — unit count not confirmed between those two figures; do not publish either as settled. One listing records pets allowed with restrictions.
Gabriola Park (Royale Properties) — 20498 82 Avenue. Strata

Listings record Sub-Type Townhouse / Row-Townhouse, Title to Land Freehold Strata, built 2016–2019 by phase/unit (listings checked show 2016, 2017 and 2019 — a single project year would be wrong), described as an award-winning, pet-friendly strata with a clubhouse. Listings record pets allowed and rentals allowed for single units (listing data — confirm on the Form B). Unit count: Not confirmed.
Kensington Lofts (Vesta Properties) — 8371 202B Street. Strata

Listings record Sub-Type Townhouse, Ownership Type Freehold Strata, built 2019–2020 by unit (listings checked show both years), 3-storey townhomes with rooftop patios a recurring feature. Unit count: Not confirmed. Published rental/pet restrictions: Not confirmed beyond listing fee data — confirm on the Form B.
Willow Park Estates (also written Willowpark Estates) — 6467 197 Street. Strata, 55+

Townhouse complex, built 1987, 64 units per the building source. A current listing (Oct 2026) calls it a "pet-friendly 55+ community" close to shopping and transit, with pets recorded as cats OK, dogs OK, number limit two, with restrictions; the building source records the strata restrictions as age restrictions, pets allowed with restrictions, and rentals not allowed — the "rentals not allowed" line is void for long-term rentals since Nov 24, 2022.
Bakerview Estates — 20582 67 Avenue. Strata

A current listing records Building Type Townhouse, Ownership Type Freehold Strata, built 2004, 10 units in the development, with listing text stating 3 pets allowed with no height restrictions (listing data — confirm on the Form B). No age restriction appears in the sources checked — not 55+.
Westbrooke freehold row homes (Foxridge Homes BC, Qualico) — Willoughby (Westbrooke community, beside Willoughby Town Centre). FEE-SIMPLE

The builder's own completion report states Foxridge completed the first section of its freehold row housing project as part of phase one of Qualico Communities' Westbrooke development in Langley: 21 buildings with 56 units (duplexes, triplexes and quadplexes), construction begun June 2020 with the final resident moved in at the end of January in the report year, and states the tenure expressly — freehold row homes have "the same ownership structure as a single-family home. A street address for the cluster: Not confirmed in the source read.

items.t: The name Willoughby was suggested for the post office at the corner of 208 Street and 83 Avenue after the settler Willoughby, per the Township schools history document held by SD35. Buyers also search "Yorkson," "Latimer Heights," and by the hubs — Langley Events Centre, Carvolth Exchange and Willoughby Town Centre.

Where the townhouse stock concentrates: (1) the Yorkson / 208 Street node around 82–84 Avenue — Yorkson Creek, Gabriola Park, Luxia at Yorkson; (2) the Latimer / 200–204 Street corridor — Cascadia, Kensington Lofts; (3) the southwest edge on 197 Street and 64–67 Avenue — Willow Park Estates, Bakerview Estates — the area's older stock.

The report combines condos and townhomes in one "attached" category and publishes no Willoughby Heights–specific median; Langley-wide (Township and City combined) attached figures for September 2026 are: median sale price $611,000; $513 per sq ft; sale-to-list 97%; 25 days on market — cited exactly as the report states them, as "Condos & Townhomes" combined, never as a townhome-only figure.

Transit and roads: Highway 1 runs along the north boundary with the 200 Street, 208 Street and 216 Street interchanges; route 501 runs Surrey Central Station to Langley Centre via Fraser Highway and 200 Street, route 372 runs Clayton Heights to Langley Centre via 72 Avenue, and route 595 runs Langley Centre to Maple Ridge via the Golden Ears Bridge; service hubs are the Langley Events Centre / Carvolth Exchange area at 200 Street and Highway 1.

items.t: Fee-simple townhomes (Westbrooke, Brighton West, non-strata row houses): The Westbrooke builder source makes the same point: full ownership of building and land, no strata corporation unless owners later create one for a joint project.

Township zoning: Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 governs. Willoughby's compact-lot pattern is the Residential Compact Lot Zone R-CL: under s. 403.7, R-CL lots run from a minimum lot area of 220 m² to a maximum of 464.5 m², with minimum frontage of 11 m front-loaded and 8.2 m rear-loaded. A coach house is a fee-simple second unit under s. 102, never strata.

items.t: Cascadia is still inside its new-home warranty window: listings note 2-5-10 warranty coverage with the building envelope to 2029 and structural to 2034 for the 2024 build — a diligence item (warranty transfer and claims history) that older-complex buyers never get to ask about.

Trinity Western University's Smith campus is inside the area at 8086 - 208 Street, and the university's campus expansion in southeast Willoughby is named in the Township's phase-1 background paper — part of the rental-demand story Yorkson landlords cite.

Yorkson Creek runs through the east side, and Township Willoughby materials flag hazards around greenways and creeks in the plan area — check creek and greenway setbacks on east-side lots before pricing a renovation or addition.

Care and hospital anchors are on the wider Langley corridors, not in the townhouse nodes: Langley Memorial Hospital, 22051 Fraser Highway (Fraser Health), and the Langley Urgent and Primary Care Centre at 202 - 20434 64 Avenue, at its permanent location per Fraser Health. Muriel Arnason Library, 130 - 20338 65 Avenue, is the Fraser Valley Regional Library branch in Willoughby.

blocks.text: Willoughby Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

446 townhomes sold in Willoughby Heights with a median price of $830,500 (the middle half sold between $755,000 and $919,900), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 98.6% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $544 per square foot, a median year built of 2018 and a median strata fee of $314 a month. 390 condos sold in Willoughby Heights with a median price of $560,000 (the middle half sold between $465,000 and $625,000), taking a median of 25 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $649 per square foot, a median year built of 2022 and a median strata fee of $393 a month.

faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 353 condos and townhomes listed in Willoughby Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Willoughby Heights?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Willoughby Heights had a sales ratio of 20%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Willoughby Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: 408 condos and townhomes sold in Willoughby Heights over those 5 months, out of 694 in all of Langley.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Willoughby Heights from June to October 2026?

faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
